metadata.description: Environment name. It is part of the unique token, so changing it creates a new set of resources.
Create the Foundry project under the reused Foundry account.
Tags applied to every created resource.

$fxv#0.description: Nonsecret deployment contract for the PMO Portfolio Prioritization solution. Read by infra/bicep (loadJsonContent) and infra/terraform (jsondecode(file())). Holds identifiers and names only, never secrets. OneLake (the Fabric lakehouse) is the single data store for everything the UI and API show or write.

reuse.description: Existing shared resources. IaC references them as read-only and never modifies or deletes them.

create.description: New resources created for this solution inside the shared resource group. Bicep names follow az{resourcePrefix}{uniqueToken}. Terraform names follow azurecaf CAF names built from baseName with no suffix.

foundryProject.name: pmo-portfolio
foundryProject.description: Foundry project for the PMO portfolio prioritization solution.

entra.description: Entra SPA app registration used by the UI for sign-in. The deploy script adds the hosted UI URL to its redirect URIs.

deployment.description: Entry points for infra/scripts/deploy.ps1. Bicep and Terraform deploy the same resources from this one config. Deploy only one flavor per environment, because both claim the APIM API path.
deployment.name: pmo-portfolio

fabric.description: Fabric items are created by fabric/scripts (deploy scripts), not by IaC. The API identity needs Contributor on the workspace so it can read and write OneLake and run the pipeline.

properties.description: PMO portfolio prioritization data, scores, and recommendations.
